'''Dawn Wind''' is a horse owned by [[Elenia Sarand]].

==Appearance==
Dawn Wind is a bay horse with long legs.

==Activities==
Dawn Wind carries Lady Elenia as she rides through [[Arymilla Marne]]'s camp near [[Caemlyn]].
